svg.title: Route selection engine internals
svg.desc: A diagram showing the internal flow of a route-selection engine. Input is a route request; output is a ranked list of routes with quotes. In between are five processing stages drawing on multiple live data feeds.

g.text: Pulls the 26 candidate routes from T7
Hits NEAR Intents solvers, BasicSwap order
Applies T9 risk overlay with live updates
Solver rep, contract status, liquidity depth
Adjusted by user's risk tolerance input
